key_insight: DobicVLM improves chest X-ray report generation by combining supervised fine-tuning with clinically grounded, rule-based reinforcement rewards to better match radiology standards.
clinical_relevance: The approach may help produce more structured, faithful, and clinically useful radiology reports in settings where transparent and resource-efficient alignment methods are needed.
method: Fine-tuned MedGemma-4B on de-identified chest X-ray image-report pairs.
Applied Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rule-based rewards for structure, anatomy, semantics, and length.
Used no neural reward model, emphasizing interpretability and clinical grounding.
evidence_signal: Trained on 1,000 private dataset pairs and evaluated by blinded experts on 69 held-out cases, where DobicVLM beat Gemini 2.5 Flash on most criteria, including impression accuracy and medical terminology.
watch_item: Results come from a relatively small, single private dataset, so broader validation and careful attention to generalizability are still needed.
paper_title: DobicVLM: Aligning Chest X-Ray Report Generation with Clinically-Grounded Programmatic Rewards via Group Relative Policy Optimization
